description: Grafana v2 example for vault-solver metrics. Uses example scrape labels namespace and pod; adapt selectors, grouping and table fields to your collection setup. Choose a Prometheus-compatible datasource. Counters cover the selected interval; current state uses current samples. Missing data is not a healthy state.

spec.title: Quote decisions
spec.description: Selected pods and time range. Fixed-height, sortable rows; use the horizontal scrollbar or choose fewer pods for details.

spec.title: Quote latency — selected pods
spec.description: Percentiles from the combined histogram buckets of the selected pods; not an average of pod percentiles. Individual pod p95 is in Pod details.

spec.title: HTTP status totals
spec.description: Selected pods and time range. Fixed-height, sortable rows; use the horizontal scrollbar or choose fewer pods for details.

spec.title: Quoted token amounts
spec.description: Input/output atomic units are tabular because token decimals differ. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Pod details
spec.description: One row per pod observed in the selected interval. Readiness and active orders are current samples; quotes/wins/fills cover the selected interval. Retired pods have no current state. Zero event timestamps display Not observed, never as a fresh event. Per-pod quote p95 keeps slow pods visible.

spec.expr: clamp_min(time() - (max by (namespace, pod) (solver_bot_workflow_last_event_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="rfq-filler",event="order_poll",outcome="success"}) > 0), 0) or ((max by (namespace, pod) (solver_bot_workflow_last_event_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="rfq-filler",event="order_poll",outcome="success"}) == 0) - 1)

clamp_min(time() - (max by (namespace, pod) (max_over_time(solver_bot_workflow_last_event_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="rfq-filler",event="fill",outcome="success"}[$__range])) > 0), 0) or ((max by (namespace, pod) (max_over_time(solver_bot_workflow_last_event_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="rfq-filler",event="fill",outcome="success"}[$__range])) == 0) - 1)

spec.title: Order-poll outcomes
spec.description: Selected pods and time range. Fixed-height, sortable rows; use the horizontal scrollbar or choose fewer pods for details.

spec.title: Fill transaction outcomes
spec.description: Exact terminal txmanager outcomes over the selected range. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Successful fill amounts
spec.description: Receipt-confirmed token amounts; planned surplus is not realized PnL. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Pods ready
spec.description: Ready pods / currently observed RFQ pods. A missing readiness sample does not count as ready. Historical pods remain in the table, not in this current-state percentage.

spec.expr: sum(min by (namespace, pod) (solver_bot_service_ready{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""})) / count(max by (namespace, pod) (solver_bot_solver_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="rfq-filler"}))

spec.title: Execution cost by pod
spec.description: Receipt-based transaction costs by pod. Fees are native-token units (wei / 1e18), not profit. Included transaction count includes confirmed and included_unconfirmed outcomes.

spec.title: Conversion
spec.description: Quoted decisions / all quote decisions across the selected pods and time range. No activity means zero quote decisions; missing samples remain No data.

title: Vault Solver · RFQ Fleet

spec.name: pods
spec.label: Pods
spec.description: All expands to the pod names discovered for this solver and selected time range.
